an3.137:1.1: seyyathāpi bhikkhave, yāni kānici tantāvutānaṃ vatthānaṃ, kesakambalo tesaṃ pāvārānaṃ patikiṭṭho akkhāyati.
an3.137:1.2: kesakambalo bhikkhave, sīte sīto, uṇhe uṇho, dubbaṇṇo, duggandho, dukkhasamphasso.
an3.137:1.3: evameva kho bhikkhave, yāni kānici puthusamaṇappavādānaṃ makkhalivādo tesaṃ patikiṭṭho akkhāyati.
an3.137:2.3: yepi te bhikkhave, ahesuṃ atītamaddhānaṃ arahanto sammāsambuddhā, tepi bhagavanto kammavādā ceva ahesuṃ kiriyavādā ca viriyavādā ca.
an3.137:2.6: yepi te bhikkhave, bhavissanti anāgatamaddhānaṃ arahanto sammāsambuddhā, tepi bhagavanto kammavādā ceva bhavissanti kiriyavādā ca viriyavādā ca.
an3.137:2.9: ahampi bhikkhave, etarahi arahaṃ sammāsambuddho kammavādo ca kiriyavādo ca viriyavādo ca.
an3.137:3.1: seyyathāpi bhikkhave, nadīmukhe khipaṃ oḍḍeyya bahunnaṃ macchānaṃ ahitāya dukkhāya anayāya vyasanāya.
an3.137:3.2: evameva kho bhikkhave, makkhalī moghapuriso manussakhipaṃ maññe loke uppanno bahunnaṃ sattānaṃ ahitāya dukkhāya anayāya vyasanāyāti.
